claims.text: Masked Document Generation (MDG) is a task that learns to recover a document with a masked span of tokens.
MDG involves predicting the original text of a document after applying a masking strategy to certain tokens.
The task is part of pre-training for sequence-to-sequence models, alongside other tasks like Sentence Reordering and Next Sentence Generation.
